items.title: ggml/llama.cpp releases: b11703
items.description:
<details open>

hexagon: vectorize softplus with HVX (#30435)

softplus_f32 and tile_softplus_f32 ran a scalar logf(1.0f + expf(x)) loop.
Replace both with a shared hvx_softplus_f32_aa() helper built from the
backend's existing hvx_vec_exp_f32 / hvx_vec_log_f32 primitives, so no new
numerical approx

items.title: How to make System 1 LLMs show System 2 competencies?
items.summary: The article discusses methods for enhancing large language models (LLMs) to exhibit more critical thinking and analytical skills, akin to human cognitive function. This is crucial as current LLMs primarily rely on pattern recognition, limiting their ability to handle complex tasks requiring deeper reasoning.
items.summary_detailed: Researchers are exploring methods to enhance large language models (LLMs), which operate primarily on a "System 1" basis—fast, intuitive, and often unconscious—to exhibit more "System 2" traits, such as deeper reasoning, critical thinking, and ethical considerations. This involves developing new training techniques and frameworks that can imbue LLMs with the ability to handle complex tasks requiring sustained mental effort. The broader impact could revolutionize fields like law, medicine, and education by creating AI tools capable of providing nuanced and thoughtful assistance rather than just surface-level responses.
items.summary_bullets:
• Integrate domain-specific knowledge into LLM training.
• Implement fact-checking mechanisms during response generation.
• Encourage diverse and balanced data representation in datasets.
